title: I turned an image of Raz from Arena of Valor into an animated 3D character with Three.js
author: Feisty-Scheme-8356
selftext:
I gave img2threejs an image of Raz from Arena of Valor and tried to see how far I could take it.

The first step is simple:

Image → 3D.

But I don’t want the pipeline to stop at generating a model.

I want that image to eventually become something you can actually use:

Image → 3D → Rigging → Animation → VFX → interactive Three.js.

This Raz experiment was built with the newly released img2threejs v1.5.2.

It’s open source, so if you’re experimenting with AI, Three.js or browser-based 3D, I’d love to see what happens when you give it your own images.

Repo + live demo in the comments.
